## Here are 2026’s best pumpkin treats shipped nationwide


We’re feeling extra festive with the return of pumpkin season. Few things signal fall quite like pumpkin desserts, pumpkin spice lattes, and all things PSL.


Pumpkins grow in every state across the U.S., making them one of America’s most beloved fall flavors. As a native North American squash, this versatile fruit shines in both sweet and savory creations.


The best pumpkin desserts fall into seven categories: pies, cakes, piecakes, whoopie pies, ice cream, cheesecake, and donuts. So grab a fork and dig into the best pumpkin desserts to celebrate the cozy flavors of fall.

## **What is the Most Popular Dessert Made from Pumpkins?**


Pumpkin pie is the most popular dessert made from pumpkins. There are many types of pumpkins grown in the U.S., falling into two categories: pumpkins used for decorating for holidays like Halloween, and pumpkins used for pies.


Varieties of pumpkins used for decorating include Connecticut Field, Howden, and Tandy F1 Hybrid pumpkins. Pumpkins for pies are smaller and sweeter — pie pumpkin varieties include Long Island cheese and sugar pumpkins.


While pumpkin desserts are popular in the fall, they are delicious year-round.


## **Pumpkin Pies**


It wouldn’t be fall or Thanksgiving without this[pumpkin pie](https://www.goldbelly.com/foods/pumpkin-pie) . This orange-hued custard pie is made from strained, cooked gourds. For centuries, the British, and then Americans, have used orange squash for baking pumpkin pies.


### **** **** **Sweetie Pies Bakery’s Pumpkin Pie**


Mmm…pie, oh my! Toni Chiappetta has been making her famous pies since 1988. Sweetie Pies’ Pumpkin Pie is a cutie pie made with pumpkin purée, allspice, brown sugar, cinnamon, ginger, and nutmeg. This classic American pie is baked in Napa Valley, California, and topped with pastry “leaves” before it’s shipped nationwide.

### **Wick’s Pies Pumpkin Spice Pie**


Duane “Wick’’ Wickersham first made pies at an Indiana factory in the 1940s. The popularity of his pies led to the opening of Wick’s Pies in Winchester, Indiana. One of their most popular pies is Pumpkin Spice Pie. Each is made from a secret family recipe that includes sweet cream and extra spices, including cinnamon, clove, coriander, ginger, and nutmeg.

Chesapeake Bay Gourmet’s Pumpkin Spice Smith Island Cake is a towering 12 layers of pumpkin cake frosted with creamy cream cheese frosting.

What started as a food blog and a passion for baking has turned into a celebrated cake company in Charlotte, North Carolina. Miri Nadler Cake Design bakes 6-inch layer cakes that are hand decorated with beautiful flowers.


Miri Nadler Cakes’ Floral Decorated Pumpkin Cake combines the top flavor of fall with elaborate cake design. Each cake features pumpkin spiced sponge cake, vanilla Swiss meringue buttercream, and signature frosting flowers. Each cake is decorated with two peach roses and a large coral peony.

## **Pumpkin Desserts**


We love pumpkin spice and everything nice. America’s top food makers are creating cute and delicious[pumpkin desserts](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/pumpkin-desserts) and fabulous[fall desserts](https://www.goldbelly.com/collections/fall-desserts) that are pure perfection.


### **PieCaken Bakeshop’s Original PieCaken**


Thanks to pastry chef Zac Young’s sense of humor, creativity, and culinary talent, the world has PieCaken. The PieCaken was created as an NYC hotel holiday dessert. It exploded in popularity after its debut, causing a pumpkin purée shortage in New York in 2015.


The Original PieCaken is a three-in-one pie-cake dessert. The monstrous dessert is a tri-level delight with cinnamon buttercream slathered between pecan pie, pumpkin pie, and spice cake.


[Original PieCaken >](https://www.goldbelly.com/restaurants/the-piecaken-shop/the-piecaken)


### **Three Brothers Bakery’s Pumpecapple Piecake**


Brothers Sigmund, Sol, and Max Jucker started baking in Poland in 1932. They carried on the tradition when they came to Houston, Texas in 1949. Seven decades on, their Polish bakery, Three Brothers Bakery, continues to bake their legendary treats like the 23.5 lbs Pumpecapple.


The Pumpecapple is the dessert answer to the turducken. It’s a 3-layer dessert with a pumpkin pie baked in a pumpkin spice cake, a pecan pie baked in a chocolate cake, and an apple pie baked in a traditional spice cake. Each layer is frosted in cream cheese frosting and the entire cake is showered in pecans and caramel drizzle.

## **Pumpkin Dessert FAQs**


**What is the most popular pumpkin dessert?**


Pumpkin pie is the most popular dessert made from pumpkins in the U.S., traditionally served at Thanksgiving but enjoyed throughout fall.


**What’s the difference between pumpkin pie and pumpkin cheesecake?**


Pumpkin pie is a custard-based pie made from strained, cooked pumpkin baked into a pastry crust. Pumpkin cheesecake swaps the custard for a cream-cheese filling flavored with pumpkin and spices, typically on a graham cracker crust — richer and denser than traditional pumpkin pie.


**Are pumpkin desserts only available in the fall?**


No, while pumpkin desserts are most popular in fall, most bakeries make them year-round. Fall is simply peak season for flavor and variety.
